intent: Compose temporal coordinates and their transport without creating an implicit product clock.

clusters.title: Clocks and conversions
clusters.summary: Explicit adapters and a conversion graph between temporal units.
clusters.authority: Each adapter owns its reading; the graph owns their local resolution.

clusters.title: Transport
clusters.summary: Atomic transitions for play, pause, seek, rate, and tick.

clusters.title: Scheduling and invalidation
clusters.summary: Frame budgeting and coordination through an explicit scheduling host.
clusters.authority: Local lifecycle of the consumer-supplied scheduler.

clusters.title: Immutable history
clusters.summary: Admission and reading of detached, frozen values.
clusters.authority: Local history created by the consumer.
